throughline.zh: 本期涵蓋台灣晶圓、HBM、封裝測試、機櫃電源與終端工廠，以及馬來西亞人才和越南資料中心電價。
throughline.en: This edition covers Taiwan wafers, HBM, packaging and test, rack power and factories, alongside Malaysian talent and Vietnam data-center tariffs.

title.zh: 本週追蹤：台積電 CoWoS 量產與美光台中 HBM 封裝測試廠啟用
title.en: Weekly follow-up: TSMC CoWoS production and Micron’s Taichung HBM assembly/test opening

summary.zh: 台積電 10 月 15 日法說表示，5 倍光罩尺寸的 CoWoS 已進入量產；同一天，美光在台中啟用支援 HBM 的 AATT2 先進封裝測試廠。兩件事都是本週稍早的進展，雙方都未公布新增產能數字。
summary.en: TSMC said at its October 15 earnings call that its five-reticle CoWoS platform is in volume production. The same day, Micron opened its AATT2 advanced assembly and test plant in Taichung for HBM. Both are developments from earlier this week, and neither company disclosed added capacity.

text.zh: AI 晶片從晶圓製造出發，經過封裝與 HBM 整合、測試後，才交給伺服器廠組裝。因此任何一段的良率或交期卡住，都會限制最終出貨，各廠的擴產公告也不能直接加總成可用的系統數量。
text.en: AI chips start in wafer fabs, then are packaged with HBM and tested before server makers assemble them. A yield or lead-time problem at any step limits final shipments, so separate expansion announcements cannot simply be added up into usable systems.

text.zh: HBM 用於加速器封裝，伺服器 DRAM 用於系統記憶體，NAND 與企業 SSD 則用於儲存。TrendForce 9 月 30 日的研究指出，伺服器與企業 SSD 需求較強，消費端採購偏保守；這是研究機構的預測，不代表所有記憶體廠的獲利會同步成長。
text.en: HBM goes into accelerator packages, server DRAM into system memory, and NAND and enterprise SSDs into storage. TrendForce's September 30 research saw stronger server and enterprise SSD demand but cautious consumer buying; that is a forecast, not evidence that every memory maker's profits are rising.

text.zh: 前段製程仰賴蝕刻、沉積與設備電源，後段則看基板、接合、探針、燒機與可靠度測試。TrendForce 10 月 13 日列出 MPI、WinWay、Chroma 與 ASE 等台灣廠商在測試與封裝的角色，不過這是產業分工圖，並未顯示它們因這兩件事取得新訂單。
text.en: Front-end processes rely on etch, deposition and tool power; back-end steps depend on substrates, bonding, probes, burn-in and reliability testing. TrendForce's October 13 map places Taiwan's MPI, WinWay, Chroma and ASE in testing and packaging roles, though it does not show new orders tied to these events.

text.zh: 台積電同日公布第三季實績：美元營收 467.2 億美元、毛利率 66.4%；新台幣營收約 1.494 兆元、年增 50.9%，淨利 7,630.6 億元、年增 68.7%。美元與新台幣的成長率各自計算，不宜混用。
text.en: TSMC reported third-quarter results the same day: revenue of US$46.72 billion and a 66.4% gross margin; Taiwan-dollar revenue of about NT$1.494 trillion, up 50.9% year on year, and net income of NT$763.06 billion, up 68.7%. Growth rates in each currency are calculated separately and should not be mixed.

ceoView.zh: 台積電 CoWoS 量產與美光 HBM 封測廠啟用，代表蝕刻、沉積等前段製程與先進封裝的電漿與射頻電源需求仍在延續。CEO 會追問台灣客戶的設備交機排程是否跟上這些產能、哪些製程需要更高精度的功率控制，以及在台服務與備品是否足以支援新廠爬坡。新增產出未披露，應以客戶實際下單與交機時程驗證，不宜直接推估營收。
ceoView.en: TSMC's CoWoS production and Micron's HBM assembly-and-test opening point to continued demand for plasma and RF power in etch, deposition and advanced packaging. A CEO would ask whether Taiwanese customers' tool delivery schedules track this capacity, which processes need tighter power control, and whether local service and spares can support new-fab ramps. Added output is undisclosed, so customer orders and tool-delivery timing are the evidence to watch, not a revenue estimate.

title.zh: 台廠於聖荷西 OCP 展示整機櫃、800 VDC 電源與液冷
title.en: Taiwan vendors exhibit racks, 800 VDC power and liquid cooling at OCP in San Jose

summary.zh: 據中央社 10 月 17 日整理，OCP 全球高峰會 10 月 12 至 15 日在美國聖荷西舉行，台廠是展場主角之一：緯穎、華碩與勤誠展出新一代伺服器與機櫃，台達電、光寶與康舒則主打高壓直流電源。台達電 10 月 15 日發布的資料列出 800 VDC 電源櫃、備援與液冷產品，這些仍是展示規格，不等於已量產部署。
summary.en: According to CNA's October 17 roundup, Taiwanese suppliers featured prominently at the OCP Global Summit in San Jose on October 12–15: Wiwynn, ASUS and Chenbro showed new servers and racks, while Delta, Lite-On and AcBel focused on high-voltage DC power. Delta's October 15 release lists 800 VDC power racks, backup and liquid cooling, though these are exhibit specifications rather than production deployments.

text.zh: 晶片、HBM 與封裝完成後，還需要主機板、網路、機構件、電源、備援、冷卻與整機測試，才能變成可交付的機櫃。也因此，客戶何時驗收取決於系統可用率與機房供電，而不只是算力規格。
text.en: After chips, HBM and packaging, a rack still needs boards, networking, mechanics, power, backup, cooling and system testing before it can ship. Customer acceptance therefore depends on availability and site power, not compute specifications alone.

text.zh: 台達電列出 660 kW 電源櫃與 480 kW 備援規格，這是產品的額定能力，並非客戶實際用電或已售出的容量；800 V 則是供電架構的電壓，不是節電比例。台達電、光寶與康舒同場展出，讓高壓直流電源有了比較基礎，但各廠同規格的成本、效率曲線與量產訂單都未公開，目前還看不出市占變化。
text.en: Delta lists a 660 kW power rack and a 480 kW backup rating; these are product ratings, not customers' actual consumption or sold capacity, and 800 V describes the architecture's voltage rather than an energy saving. With Delta, Lite-On and AcBel exhibiting side by side, high-voltage DC designs can now be compared, but comparable costs, efficiency curves and production orders are not public, so market-share shifts cannot yet be judged.

text.en: Comparable prices, costs, customer orders and deployed volumes have not been disclosed.

ceoView.zh: 800 VDC 機櫃供電與液冷成為台廠展示重點，顯示資料中心電源架構正朝高壓直流發展。對電源轉換廠商而言，關鍵在轉換效率、功率密度與認證時程，以及與台達、光寶等台灣電源廠是競爭還是合作。CEO 會檢視產品藍圖是否涵蓋 800 V 架構、是否需要與 ODM 及雲端客戶共同驗證；展示不等於量產訂單，仍需追蹤實際部署。
ceoView.en: 800 VDC rack power and liquid cooling led Taiwanese exhibits, signalling a shift toward high-voltage DC in data-center power. For a power-conversion maker the questions are efficiency, power density and qualification timing, and whether Delta or Lite-On are competitors or partners. A CEO would check whether the roadmap covers 800 V architectures and whether joint validation with ODMs and cloud customers is needed; exhibits are not production orders.

title.zh: 友達布局玻璃基板與光通訊零組件，2030 年純面板占比目標為 30%
title.en: AUO targets glass and optical components; pure-panel revenue share goal is 30% by 2030

summary.zh: 友達董事長彭双浪 10 月 17 日接受中央社專訪表示，友達將以玻璃與 TGV（玻璃通孔）技術切入先進封裝零組件，與康寧合作的技術已用於低軌衛星天線。他也預估，MicroLED 光通訊與 CPO 約兩到三年後量產。
summary.en: AUO chairman Paul Peng told CNA on October 17 that AUO will enter advanced-packaging components using glass and TGV (through-glass via) technology, and that technology developed with Corning is already used in low-earth-orbit satellite antennas. He expects MicroLED optical communications and CPO to reach volume production in about two to three years.

text.zh: 面板廠的玻璃加工能力可以延伸到封裝零組件，但封裝用玻璃對可靠度、平整度與良率的要求更高，仍需通過客戶驗證；衛星天線的應用進展，也不代表已取得半導體封裝認證。
text.en: A panel maker's glass-processing skills can extend into packaging parts, but packaging glass faces stricter reliability, flatness and yield requirements and still needs customer qualification; progress in satellite antennas does not amount to semiconductor-packaging approval.

text.zh: 報導中的 30% 是友達 2030 年純面板營收占比的目標，並不是營收下滑 30%。
text.en: The 30% in the report is AUO's target for pure-panel revenue as a share of the total in 2030, not a 30% revenue decline.

text.zh: 目前資訊來自具名專訪，尚未取得逐字稿、客戶認證進度與新業務的獲利資料。
text.en: The information comes from a named interview; a transcript, customer qualification status and new-business profitability are not yet available.

ceoView.zh: 面板廠跨入玻璃基板與 TGV 封裝零組件，先進封裝材料的供應來源可能增加。玻璃加工、雷射鑽孔與鍍膜同樣需要穩定的電漿與精密電源控制，CEO 可能把這類業者視為新的製程設備客群；但量產要等兩到三年，客戶認證也未確定，較適合先建立技術接觸並觀察驗證進度。
ceoView.en: A panel maker moving into glass substrates and TGV packaging parts could widen the supply base for advanced-packaging materials. Glass processing, laser drilling and coating also rely on stable plasma and precision power control, so a CEO might see a new process-tool customer group. Volume production is two to three years out and customer qualification is unconfirmed, so early technical contact and tracking qualification fit better than near-term plans.

title.zh: RTX Spark 電腦 10 月 16 日上市，台灣設計、封裝與品牌串接終端 AI
title.en: RTX Spark PCs launch October 16, connecting Taiwan design, packaging and brands to local AI

summary.zh: NVIDIA 10 月 16 日宣布 RTX Spark Windows 電腦上市，華碩、微星等品牌推出搭載 Grace CPU 與 Blackwell GPU 的機種。NVIDIA 主管向中央社表示，聯發科參與了 CPU 設計，平台並採用 CoWoS 封裝。
summary.en: NVIDIA launched RTX Spark Windows PCs on October 16, with ASUS, MSI and other brands offering models built on Grace CPUs and Blackwell GPUs. An NVIDIA executive told CNA that MediaTek contributed to the CPU design and that the platform uses CoWoS packaging.

metricLabel.zh: 公司公布的最高統一記憶體規格

text.zh: 這款平台把台灣的晶片設計、先進封裝與 PC 品牌串在一起：聯發科參與 CPU 設計，平台採 CoWoS 封裝，華碩、微星等品牌推出終端產品。公司公布的最高統一記憶體規格為 128 GB；需求與產能的說法都來自 NVIDIA，HBM 用量也尚未證實。
text.en: The platform links Taiwan's chip design, advanced packaging and PC brands: MediaTek contributed CPU design, the platform uses CoWoS packaging, and ASUS and MSI build the end products. NVIDIA lists up to 128 GB of unified memory; demand and capacity claims come from NVIDIA, and HBM content is unconfirmed.

title.zh: 經濟部說明赴美園區由業者籌資，每座估 20 億至 40 億美元
title.en: Taiwan says planned U.S. parks would be privately funded at an estimated $2–4 billion each

summary.zh: 經濟部 10 月 16 日向中央社說明，將與電電公會推動海外產業園區，由業者出資、政府協助。部長龔明鑫在專訪中表示，計畫從美國德州起步，規劃不只一座，單一園區估計需要 20 億至 40 億美元。
summary.en: Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs told CNA on October 16 that it will work with TEEMA on overseas industrial parks funded by companies with government support. Minister Kung Ming-hsin said in an interview that the plan starts in Texas and will include more than one park, each estimated at US$2–4 billion.

text.zh: 20 億至 40 億美元來自部長與經濟部對媒體的說明，屬於規劃估算；目前沒有融資、預算或土地契約文件，因此既不是政府已編列的支出，也不是業者已承諾的投資。
text.en: The US$2–4 billion figure comes from the minister and ministry statements to media and is a planning estimate. Without financing, budget or land documents, it is neither appropriated government spending nor capital that companies have committed.

text.zh: 開發主體、園區用地、完整融資方式與進駐廠商名單都尚未確認。
text.en: The developer, land, full financing and tenant list have not been confirmed.

ceoView.zh: 台灣廠商若在德州等地設立海外園區，美國在地的電子製造與設備需求可能增加，總部在美國的電源與量測設備商有機會就近服務台灣客戶的美國據點。不過目前只是規劃估算，用地、資金與進駐廠商都未確認；CEO 會先向既有台灣客戶確認其美國擴廠時程，再評估在地銷售與服務配置。
ceoView.en: Taiwanese industrial parks in Texas could add local electronics manufacturing and tool demand, letting a U.S.-based power and measurement company serve Taiwanese customers' U.S. sites up close. These are planning estimates with land, funding and tenants unconfirmed, so a CEO would first confirm existing Taiwanese customers' U.S. timelines before planning local sales and service.

title.zh: 中經院上修台灣全年成長預測至 12.16%，需分開看實績與展望
title.en: CIER raises Taiwan’s full-year growth forecast to 12.16%; distinguish results from projections

summary.zh: 中經院 10 月 16 日公布最新預測，將台灣 2026 年經濟成長率從 7 月預估的 10.35% 上修至 12.16%，增加 1.81 個百分點。其中內需預估貢獻 6.63 個百分點，國外淨需求貢獻 5.53 個百分點。
summary.en: CIER's October 16 forecast raised Taiwan's 2026 GDP growth estimate from July's 10.35% to 12.16%, up 1.81 percentage points. Domestic demand is expected to contribute 6.63 points and net external demand 5.53 points.

metricLabel.zh: 中經院 2026 年全年 GDP 成長預測

text.zh: 中經院認為 AI 需求、企業擴產與國內投資是主要動能，同時提醒融資、地緣政治與 AI 資安等不確定因素。
text.en: CIER sees AI demand, corporate expansion and domestic investment as the main drivers, while flagging financing, geopolitical and AI-security uncertainties.

text.zh: 10.35% 與 12.16% 是同一年度在不同時間點的預測。第四季預估年增 8.20%，去年同期基期較高；增速放緩本身不代表當季產出減少。
text.en: 10.35% and 12.16% are two forecasts for the same year made at different times. Fourth-quarter growth is projected at 8.20% against a high base a year earlier; slower growth on its own does not mean output is shrinking.

text.zh: 全年數字仍是預測，實際結果要等官方統計，屆時可能修正。
text.en: The full-year figure is still a forecast and may be revised once official data are released.

ceoView.en: Taiwan's growth forecast rising to 12.16%, driven by AI demand and corporate investment, suggests a still-strong capex environment among Taiwanese customers. A CEO would treat it as macro background alongside individual customer expansion plans, currency and geopolitical risk; forecasts can be revised and should not drive order expectations on their own.

title.zh: 胡志明市要求釐清 AI 資料中心電價，投資模型面臨費率認定
title.en: Ho Chi Minh City seeks clarity on AI data-center power tariffs

summary.zh: 據 TNGlobal 10 月 16 日報導，胡志明市工業區管理機關在 10 月 15 日的經濟會議上，要求釐清並統一 AI 資料中心的電價適用規則。相關的 AIC 與 KBC 計畫早在 3 月就已公布，總投資規劃 21 億美元；這次的新進展是電價問題，而不是新的投資。
summary.en: According to TNGlobal on October 16, Ho Chi Minh City's industrial-zone authority asked at an October 15 economic meeting for unified guidance on power tariffs for AI data centers. The related AIC–KBC project, with a planned US$2.1 billion investment, was announced in March; the new development is the tariff question, not new investment.

metricLabel.zh: 既有資料中心計畫金額

text.zh: 爭點在於資料中心該適用商業電價還是製造業電價。電價較高會推升營運成本，也可能影響財務可行性與建設進度；不過最終費率、用電曲線與財務模型都還沒公開，目前無法估算確切差額。
text.en: The question is whether data centers pay business or manufacturing tariffs. Higher tariffs would raise operating costs and could affect financial feasibility and construction timing, but final rates, load profiles and financial models are not public, so the cost difference cannot yet be estimated.

text.zh: TNGlobal 提到首期規劃最高 50 MW，而 21 億美元是整體計畫的投資規模，兩者的範圍與時程並不一致，不宜相除推算每 MW 造價；規劃容量也不等於已通電或已出租的容量。
text.en: TNGlobal cites up to 50 MW for phase one, while US$2.1 billion covers the whole project; their scope and timing differ, so dividing one by the other does not give a cost per MW, and planned capacity is not energized or leased capacity.

text.zh: 原始會議紀錄、最終電價、用電曲線與購電合約都尚未取得。
text.en: Original meeting records, final tariffs, load profiles and power contracts are not yet available.

Higher tariffs make conversion efficiency and energy management more valuable, which favours high-efficiency power products, but project scale and timing remain uncertain. A CEO would keep Vietnam on a watch list until tariffs and the 50 MW first-phase timeline are clear.

title.zh: 馬來西亞半導體招募涵蓋製程、設備與廠務，人才連結台灣供應鏈
title.en: Malaysia semiconductor recruitment spans process, equipment and facilities roles

summary.zh: 中央社 10 月 16 日報導，雪蘭莪相關機構在吉隆坡會展中心（KLCC）舉辦半導體招募活動，提供逾 1,500 個職缺，涵蓋設計、軟韌體、製程、設備與廠務。官員表示，兩座 IC 設計園區已有 20 家公司、409 名工程師，可與檳城的製造與封裝測試形成互補。
summary.en: CNA reported on October 16 that Selangor-linked institutions held a semiconductor recruitment event at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre (KLCC), offering more than 1,500 openings in design, software and firmware, process, equipment and facilities. An official said two IC design parks host 20 companies and 409 engineers, complementing Penang's manufacturing, assembly and testing.

metricLabel.zh: 活動提供的職缺，並非已聘人數

text.zh: 後段製造需要製程、測試、設備維修與廠務人員一起運作，設計聚落也要有客戶與製造端配合。職缺數量反映招募需求，但不等於實際新增就業、產能或薪資支出。
text.en: Back-end manufacturing depends on process, test, maintenance and facilities staff working together, and design clusters need customers and manufacturing partners. Openings show hiring demand, not actual new jobs, output or payroll.

text.zh: 官員也提到，雪蘭莪將與檳城及國家投資機構合作推動規模 1.5 億令吉的計畫。來源未說明撥款時程與外資比例，這是合作計畫的規模，和 FDI 統計是不同的數字。
text.en: The official also described a RM150 million program involving Selangor, Penang and the national investment agency. Disbursement timing and the foreign share were not given; this is a program budget, not an FDI figure.

text.en: Actual hires and retention have not been reported; organizer pages give October 14 or 15 as the start date, though they agree on the venue.

ceoView.en: Malaysia's push to hire design, process, equipment and facilities staff reflects growing back-end and design clusters. For a tool supplier that means more local customers and installed tools, and tighter competition for engineering and service talent. A CEO would review Malaysian service coverage and staffing, and partnerships with local universities and parks for training.

title.zh: 背景追蹤：NVIDIA 公布半導體檢測、測試與工廠 AI 合作
title.en: Background follow-up: NVIDIA announces semiconductor inspection, testing and factory AI collaborations

summary.zh: NVIDIA 10 月 14 日發布的資料列出多項合作：KLA 的檢測、Advantest 的測試，以及鴻海、FANUC 等業者的工廠 AI 應用。這是本週稍早的發布，各工廠的導入地點、量產時程與整廠投資報酬都尚未完整公開。
summary.en: NVIDIA's October 14 release lists several collaborations: KLA inspection, Advantest testing, and factory AI work with Foxconn, FANUC and others. Released earlier this week, it does not fully disclose deployment sites, production timelines or plant-wide returns.

metricLabel.zh: 觀察導入進度，尚無可核對的全廠收益

text.zh: 晶片與伺服器提供算力，檢測與測試設備產生資料，工廠再把模型接進工程、排程與現場作業。合作名單顯示可能的整合方式，但還不能證明所有設備都已串接，或同一套做法能複製到每座工廠。
text.en: Chips and servers supply compute, inspection and test tools generate data, and factories feed models into engineering, scheduling and floor operations. The partner list shows how integration could work, but it does not prove every tool is connected or that the approach transfers to every plant.

text.zh: 具名導入廠址、合約價格與可量化的整廠效益都尚未公開。
text.en: Named deployment sites, contract pricing and quantified plant-wide benefits have not been disclosed.

ceoView.zh: NVIDIA 與 KLA、Advantest 等檢測、測試及工廠自動化業者合作，代表工廠 AI 需要大量設備資料與即時控制。對精密量測與控制儀器廠商而言，設備資料介面、可程式化與即時回饋能力可能成為新的產品要求；CEO 會評估自家產品能否提供這類資料、是否需要加入相關生態系，但目前部署與效益仍未完整公開。
ceoView.en: NVIDIA's work with KLA, Advantest and factory-automation firms shows factory AI depends on rich tool data and real-time control. For precision measurement and control instruments, data interfaces, programmability and real-time feedback may become product requirements. A CEO would assess whether products can supply such data and whether to join these ecosystems, though deployments and benefits are not yet fully disclosed.

text.en: Existing sources cover wafers, HBM, packaging/test, rack power, cooling and factory AI. Malaysian talent and Vietnam investment and tariffs provide regional context; event dates and statistical periods remain separate.

title.zh: 越南前三季外資（10 月 3 日發布）

text.zh: 越南政府新聞網 10 月 3 日公布，前三季 FDI 實現額估 210.7 億美元、年增 12.1%；總註冊外資 503.6 億美元、年增 76.4%。資料截至 9 月 30 日，非本期新統計。註冊額含新案、增資與股權交易，與實現額口徑不同，不能相加或相除成落地率。
text.en: Vietnam’s government news portal reported on October 3 that estimated realized FDI reached $21.07 billion in the first nine months, up 12.1% yearly, while total registered foreign investment reached $50.36 billion, up 76.4%. Data run through September 30 and are not a new release in this edition. Registrations include new projects, additions and equity transactions, so they cannot be added to or divided by realized FDI as a completion rate.

verificationNote.zh: 本期聚焦台灣與東南亞。CoWoS、美光及 10 月 14 日工廠 AI 合作明列為追蹤。展示規格、公司目標、園區估算與 GDP 預測均非已完成訂單。友達與馬來西亞園區數字依具名採訪；胡志明市電價缺原始會議文件及最終費率，屬來源受限。未披露的訂單、基期與影響金額保持未知。 活動地點依主辦資料補充；MSRD 招募起日存在 10/14 與 10/15 兩種主辦頁記載，KLCC 場館則一致。
